title: The badge reader that missed people
hints: There are four separate bugs: the ISR sets a flag that the reader *polls* (latency up to 10 ms); `card_sem` can only count to 1; the reader can't tell "100 ms of silence" from "a card"; and `log_lock` is a semaphore, so `log_card()` -> `log_touch()` takes it twice and blocks forever.

ISR: `k_sem_give(&card_sem)`. Reader: `int rc = k_sem_take(&card_sem, K_MSEC(READER_TIMEOUT_MS));` and branch on `rc == -EAGAIN`. Give the semaphore room to count (`K_SEM_DEFINE(card_sem, 0, 16)`). Replace the lock with `K_MUTEX_DEFINE(log_lock)` and use `k_mutex_lock`/`k_mutex_unlock` everywhere, including in `cloud_thread`.

Reader loop: `int rc = k_sem_take(&card_sem, K_MSEC(READER_TIMEOUT_MS)); if (rc == -EAGAIN) { log_timeout(); continue; } k_busy_wait(CARD_WORK_US); log_card();`. Every `k_sem_take(&log_lock, K_FOREVER)` becomes `k_mutex_lock(&log_lock, K_FOREVER)`, and every `k_sem_give(&log_lock)` becomes `k_mutex_unlock(&log_lock)`. The nested lock in `log_touch()` is fine: Zephyr mutexes are recursive.
